ValidationRule.description: Win/Loss Reason must be captured when an opportunity is Closed Won or Closed Lost.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Lost') ), ISBLANK(TEXT(Win_Loss_Reason__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Win/Loss Reason before closing the opportunity.
